summary: Iteration 21 – Rekap Gaji extras (delete archive, WhatsApp slip, multi-row Potongan Lain-lain, editable Hadir/Telat/Alpha/Izin counts). Backend: 4/4 pytest PASS. Frontend E2E PASS: amber-border diff indicator + 'diedit' badge on count edits, auto-recalculate potongan on telat/alpha change (3×10000 + round(2×2600000/26) = 230000 ✓), multi-row Potongan Lain-lain (Kasbon 150k + Barang rusak 50k = Rp 200.000), bonus Lembur 100k, row total Rp 2.270.000, persistence after reload (hadir=20, telat=3, alpha=2, izin=1), WA dialog prefills saved phone, send button disabled <9 digits & enabled on valid number, archive card appears after Arsipkan, trash icon deletes with confirm + toast 'Arsip Agustus 2099 dihapus (2 slip)' and card removed. Admin-only guard on DELETE /payroll/archive/{month} and POST /payroll/phone verified (403 for kasir).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1873 lines – should be split into routers; carried over from iter20.
payroll_save upserts counts with max(0, ...) but doesn't validate upper bound (e.g. hadir>31). Minor; UI uses min=0.
PayslipWhatsAppDialog opens window.open('','_blank') synchronously then awaits POST /payroll/phone – if phone save fails the blank window stays open briefly before win?.close(); acceptable UX.
_compute_payroll fetches all users with to_list(500) and attendance to_list(5000) – fine for small shop. Add indexes on attendance.date and ecommerce_sales.created_at when scaling.
deleteArchive uses window.confirm (native). PRD-ish may prefer AlertDialog; acceptable given scope.
No server-side cap on potongan_items length / keterangan size — malicious client could spam huge list. Add length cap (same note as bonus_items from iter20).
